scope: Native XYZ move/rotation/axis scale and uniform scale renderer geometry, shared native picking and frozen-origin drag, existing transform controls and shared command history.
resolvedDependencies: One native mesh supplies depth-disabled renderer triangles and Moller-Trumbore picking; no global clear-Z/legacy rotation state.
Perspective pixel sizing, near/far suppression and camera-aligned translation/scaling suppression.
Native ray/axis move/scale, ray/plane rotation and uniform camera-plane scale constraints with native angle convention.
Versioned settings/hit/drag/delta, owner/session checks and 14 native malformed/stale rejections preserving live mesh and output sentinels.
Real HWND mouse handlers, handle priority/hover, World/Local, one multi-object command, exact undo/redo/saved marker, Escape/no-op/camera cancellation.
Exact Vulkan restores after undo, Escape, Cyrillic save/reopen and final baseline; ten workflows drain pending queries/frames with validation 0/0.
remaining: Native silhouette outlines and original glow/pulse selection parameters (current overlay is bounds only).
Camera-plane translate/scale and camera/arcball rotation handles, full original draw-style parity and remaining 16 legacy render modes.
Generic selected camera/model/asset preview view/output binding and isolation; fixed M8 woodbox preview is a regression control.
Resize/DPI/minimize, dock/float/redock, HWND recreation release/reattach and hide/destroy coverage in generic SDK views.
Active scene/preview resource reload, pending frames/queries coverage and measured incremental scene synchronization.
Real edit/play/simulate transition; shell flag is not runtime simulation acceptance.
limitations: XYZ and uniform scale subset; original camera-plane translate/scale and camera/arcball rotation handles remain open.
Native geometry is a typed renderer port, not original draw-style parity or a reuse claim for guarded legacy render calls.
Automated in-process WinForms mouse/key handlers on hidden HWNDs; physical desktop/manual smoke is not claimed.
SDK-4 scene fixtures use fresh GUIDs per run. Cross-checkpoint image differences are reported separately; saved transforms and each run's history/reopen readbacks must restore exactly.
Gizmo mesh is cached for unchanged anchor/camera/projection/size. Per-edit scene candidate rebuild remains a measured performance dependency.
Full SDK-5 stays unchecked; generic previews/output lifecycle, silhouettes, remaining modes, reload and runtime transitions remain unaccepted.
